threads.Author: claude
threads.Text: [Q] Bullet substitution is the one place a CHARACTER changes (- to •), unlike everywhere else where only style changes. Copy-from-terminal of a bullet line yields • not -. Cheap to drop if source fidelity should be absolute.
threads.SectionPath: Plan: Typora-grade in-place rendering for the view command > Implementation Phases > Phase 3: structural typography

Anchor.selected_text: Bullets render as `•`; `---` rules draw a dim line across the pane; heading `#` runs dim, titles keep their color; blockquote bars continuous.
Anchor.context_after: The `#` line-number toggle and all gutter behavior untouched.

threads.Author: claude
threads.Text: [Q] The one real divergence from Typora, my call: markers DIM but never vanish, because suggest --original must match raw source and terminal-copy of concealed text breaks that silently. Full concealment can come later behind a source-mode toggle. Veto if you want Typora-true now.
threads.SectionPath: Plan: Typora-grade in-place rendering for the view command > What We're NOT Doing

Anchor.selected_text: - No marker CONCEALMENT in v1 — markers dim, never disappear: `suggest --original` must match raw source, and terminal copy of concealed text would silently break that match. Concealment can come later behind a source-mode toggle.
Anchor.context_after: - No reflow of any kind: no table column alignment, no width-aware typography (standing rail).
